_comment: The conformance corpus inputs: for each committed pack, queries spanning simple, fanout, size-declared, sharing-heavy, external-cost, cyclic (low-confidence), and sugared (fragments/aliases/variables/directives) shapes. An entry is a query string, or {"query": ..., "variables": {...}} to quote with variable values. scripts/export_conformance.py runs each through the Python engine and freezes the full contract results into quotes.json, the oracle for the Python golden tests AND the JS port's conformance suite. conformance/union_pack.json is synthetic (scripts/make_union_pack.py): it pins fragment-branch pricing on a union schema, which no demo pack has.
packs/tmdb_t3.json: { movie(id:"27205"){ title cast(limit:4){ person{ name filmography(limit:3){ movie{ title } } } } } }
fragment F on Movie { title genres{ name } } { movie(id:"27205"){ ...F } }
{ imax: movie(id:"27205"){ title } rerelease: movie(id:"155"){ title } }
{ movie(id:"27205"){ ... on Movie { cast(limit:8) @include(if:true){ person{ name } } } } }
query($n: Int = 8){ movie(id:"27205"){ cast(limit:$n){ person{ name } } } }

packs/tmdb_t3.json.query: query($n: Int!){ movie(id:"27205"){ cast(limit:$n){ person{ name } } } }
